title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: Release of Value from a Travel Credit Voucher
content:
Where a traveller holds a travel credit voucher standing in their own name under Air Ticket Fare Brands and is holding an unticketed air booking, value may be put from that voucher against that booking. One release posts a single redemption line to the holding booking's credit ledger, the value named comes off the voucher, and the booking afterwards carries that much credit toward its price. The traveller sees the voucher balance reduced and the credit standing against the booking they are holding.

Value is released from the traveller's pooled travel credit only after a travel credit stands issued against a fare line of the cancelled booking. Until that state stands on the cancelled booking's own lines, no value is released from the pooled travel credit.

## Situation of use and capability

The instrument releases value from a travel credit voucher standing in the traveller's own name onto an air booking that traveller is holding.

## How it is invoked

The instrument is `release_travel_credit_value_2b680572`. The traveller does this themselves, because the vouchers stand in their own name: the desk performs the unlock, and the instrument is then handed over and run by the customer themselves, in a single call.

## What it is given

- `air_booking_id` — the reference number of the air booking record the value is put against, as returned by the air booking lookup for this traveller.
- `credit_voucher_code` — the voucher code as it was given when the travel credit was issued, copied character for character with the same letters, digits and punctuation, with no translation, normalisation, addition or deletion.
- `source_event_id` — the reference number of the issue line that created the voucher, as returned by the air booking event lookup.
- `passenger_sequence` — which traveller on the holding booking the released value belongs to, in ticket order, written as a whole number starting at 1; there is no empty value and no rounding, since the position is counted exactly.
- `released_credit_usd` — how much value comes off the voucher, as a positive US dollar amount with 2 decimal places, given to the cent exactly as the published terms produce it. US dollars only, and there is no empty value.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the new redemption line's reference, a string beginning "ared_", the voucher code the value came off, the air booking reference the value was put against, and the amount released in US dollars to two decimal places. The call has completed when that confirmation comes back: the value now stands against that booking.
